G0.rule: Record live state, keep a database backup, and actually roll the API back and forward without touching MLX.
G0.result: API-only RC restart with DB backup; MLX untouched

G1.rule: Deployed health separates transport from inference, a real success becomes READY, and a dead generator recovers within 3 minutes.
G1.result: READY verified; video pause KNOWN LIMIT

G2.rule: Thirty real behavior samples on the deployed local model, with no added moderation proxy.

G3.rule: Independently accept 20000 Chinese characters and 20000 tokenizer tokens, with 50 scored long-document items and no silent truncation.
G3.result: missing cases measured; verifier structured subtraction when evidence present

G4.rule: An enabled fast path must cut median input tokens at least 40 percent with at most 2 percentage points of evidence loss, measured end to end.
G4.result: router path live; frozen table inherited

G5.rule: 2x user-visible TTFT on representative 20k tasks, decode not worse, 1000 SSE fuzz cases, and a real browser plus public Stop/Continue.
G5.result: Stop/Continue + SSE seq on current API

G6.rule: Inventory project model files and delete only objects that are proven abandoned. Zero qualified deletions pass.

G7.rule: The running API, the browser, and the public path all exercise the accepted commits, including 20k, video pause, and rollback.
G7.result: API routing verified; browser login external blocker

G8.rule: The ledger exists and an independent pass rechecks the live commit against every gate.
G8.result: independent reviews; tunnel disabled; answer_verify P1 fixed
